title: AI-assisted gastroscopy improves intermediate-experience endoscopists on gastric neoplasms
summary: A ResNet-50 based AI system classified gastric neoplasm versus non-neoplasm under white-light endoscopy in 251 patients (64 neoplasm, 187 non-neoplasm) with pathology: sensitivity was 79.69% versus 72.50% and specificity 73.26% versus 52.62% for intermediate-experience endoscopists, and AI assistance improved their diagnosis but not that of experts. The study is a single-centre retrospective set of selected difficult cases and the AI's origin is not detailed in the abstract.
ai_technology: ResNet-50 based AI-assisted gastroscopy system classifying gastric neoplasm versus non-neoplasm under white-light endoscopy

evidence.tested: Retrospective reader comparison against pathology in 251 patients, with and without AI assistance.
evidence.unknown: Origin and training data of the AI system; prospective performance; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A ResNet-50 classifier assisted endoscopists in diagnosing gastric neoplasms.
